elaine_sales: Quick sync — Acme Financial POC: they want streaming SDK + tool calls + structured output. Main blockers: SSO (SAML), offline KMS, and pricing for burst GPU reserved lanes. Can we get a short checklist?

devon_presales: @sam_engineer can you confirm streaming handshake & ephemeral creds flow? Also need sample SDK snippet to show them.

sam_engineer: yep. For streaming we recommend SSE or websocket proxy. Example quick start (node):
```
const rwd = require('@redwood/inference-sdk');
const client = new rwd.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-7b', stream: true });
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk));
```
Use short-lived creds (STS) for connector -> broker. We can demo token rotation in 10m.

alice_security: Security notes — SAML SSO + SCIM okay. For offline KMS we'll need to surface HSM envelope support; we can do bring-your-own-KMS via our Private deployment. Need customer's attestation for on-prem key use. I'll draft answers for the security questionnaire (SOC2 & data residency bits).

elaine_sales: Awesome. Also they asked about billing spikes: is there a temporary burst plan or auto-burst pricing?

devon_presales: We can offer a 7-day burst window on Dedicated (charges apply). For hosted, recommend autoscaling with soft QPS limits; pricing varies by model family — I'll pull numbers.

sam_engineer: For structured output/tool-calling: show them `funcjson` example and mention streaming function call chunks. Quick snippet:
```
await client.call({ model: 'redwood-13b', input: prompt, tools: [{ name:'lookup', url:'https://svc/lookup' }] });
```
We also need to surface how fallback works if a function call times out (we return partial structured output + error metadata).

elaine_sales: Can someone drop a short bulleted handoff for the customer success POC runbook? I want to include deploy steps, minimal infra, and security checklist.

devon_presales: I'll author a 1-pager and attach after this thread. For now: 1) create account & project 2) enable streaming in console 3) set up ephemeral creds 4) verify SAML SSO 5) test KMS via staging 6) run sample streaming SDK demo 7) ramp traffic with dedicated burst if needed.

deploy-bot: build/deploy #redwood-docs: succeeded 2165432155 :white_check_mark:

elaine_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll send Acme the runbook + pricing note. :thumbsup:
